name: confetti-blast-trigger
title: Confetti Blast Trigger
description: A celebratory burst of multi-colored vector fragments detonating outward on click with gravity falloff.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Playful
Macrostructure: Symmetric
Density: Compact
Shape: Sharp
Motion: Expressive
Typography: Grotesk
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Click Detonation Blast: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
